text:
Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan was India's ambassador to the Soviet Union from 1949 to 1952, succeeding Vijaya Lakshmi Pandit, who was moving from Moscow to Washington. The shared team note is wrong: Pandit, Nehru's sister, left Moscow in 1949 rather than being posted there. The earlier answer's Wilson Center citation is also unconfirmed, since the link actually points to a UMD digital archive.
CONFIDENCE: 90
